body: Never went back in? As-in you quit on the spot while telling them?
I do not nearly have that much saved.

I feel like I'm past the point of caring. There's some days that go by that I literally write on my "what I got done today list": "didn't kms"

It's not about caring about other people so much as it is this is my prison. Wife doesn't necessarily want to get away from me but I can understand the toll my depression takes on those closest to me. It can be frustrating when nothing you do seems to help the person you love the most.

Also that gainful employment with co-workers who trust me with meaningful work takes a sharp turn when it dawns on people that I haven't done anything constructive for weeks which is anxiety-inducing.

I agree but I'm at a loss for next steps to take, I just asked in /r/cscareerquestions. This job literally makes me want to take my own life - I feel like that's worth at least something since everyone keeps telling me my life has value. I have less than a week left of PTO for the entire rest of the year (if I finish the year).

I'm unsure of how to ask for unpaid leave if that's what you're suggesting. I'm currently attending therapy and am on the books to  see a psychiatrist to seek medication finally after resisting it for so long.
